Anchor.description:
A named point on equipment where a leak can be placed.

Attributes:
    id: Anchor id, ``<equipment tag>.<name>``.
    position_m: Position in site coordinates.
    emission_point: Whether the inversion treats it as a candidate source.
Anchor.title: Anchor

Equipment.description:
One piece of equipment.

Attributes:
    tag: Unique equipment tag, for example ``K-202``.
    type: Kind of equipment.
    position_m: Footprint centre at the equipment's base (x, y = centre of the footprint,
        z = bottom of the box) in site coordinates.
    rotation_deg: Rotation about the vertical axis in degrees.
    size_m: Axis-aligned bounding box (x, y, z) in metres before rotation, centred on
        position_m in x and y and rising from it in z.
    anchors: Named leak points on this equipment.
    vents_to: Tag of the equipment this one vents to, if any.
    shelter: Whether it sits inside a shelter.
    description: Free-text description.
Equipment.title: Equipment

EquipmentType.description: Kinds of equipment on the station (value equals name).
EquipmentType.title: EquipmentType

FacilitySpec.description:
Validated description of the station.

Attributes:
    site: Site identity, bounds and location.
    gas_composition: Mole fractions by species; must sum to 1.
    operating: Normal operating conditions.
    equipment: All equipment, each with its anchors.
    piping: Pipe routes as polylines.
    instruments: All instruments.
FacilitySpec.title: FacilitySpec

Instrument.description:
One instrument.

Attributes:
    tag: Unique instrument tag, for example ``AT-101``.
    kind: Kind of instrument.
    position_m: Position in site coordinates.
    attaches_to: Tag of the equipment it measures, if any.
    noise_ppm: One-sigma noise in ppm (methane sensors only).
Instrument.title: Instrument

InstrumentKind.description: Kinds of instrument on the station (value equals name).
InstrumentKind.title: InstrumentKind

OperatingConditions.description:
Normal operating conditions of the station.

Attributes:
    suction_pressure_pa: Compressor suction absolute pressure in pascals (not gauge).
    discharge_pressure_pa: Compressor discharge absolute pressure in pascals (not gauge).
    gas_temperature_k: Gas temperature in kelvin.
    throughput_sm3_h: Throughput in standard cubic metres per hour.
OperatingConditions.title: OperatingConditions

PipeRoute.description:
A pipe route as a polyline.

Attributes:
    id: Unique route id, for example ``R-250``.
    service: What the pipe carries.
    size_in: Nominal size in inches.
    waypoints_m: Polyline points in site coordinates (at least two).
PipeRoute.title: PipeRoute

PlumeKeyframe.description:
The ground concentration grid at one time, with the wind that shaped it.

Attributes:
    t_s: Time in scenario seconds.
    wind_speed_m_s: 60 s mean wind speed in m/s.
    wind_from_deg: 60 s circular mean wind direction in degrees.
    stability: Pasquill class (A to F).
    sources: Sources active at ``t_s``.
    grid_b64: Base64 of ``encode_log_u8`` of the grid (``ny * nx`` bytes, row-major).
PlumeKeyframe.title: PlumeKeyframe

ReplayEvent.description:
One detection event on one sensor (10-minute detection window).

Attributes:
    sensor_id: Instrument tag.
    window_index: Index of the 10-minute window in which the alarm fired.
    window_start_s: Start of that window in scenario seconds.
    mean_ppm: Window mean in ppm.
    baseline_ppm: Rolling baseline in ppm.
    downwind_of_site: Whether the sensor lay downwind of the site centre.
ReplayEvent.title: ReplayEvent

ReplayGrid.description:
Geometry and encoding of every key-frame grid of the file.

Attributes:
    x0_m: West edge in m.
    y0_m: South edge in m.
    dx_m: Cell width in m.
    dy_m: Cell height in m.
    nx: Cells in x.
    ny: Cells in y.
    encoding: Byte encoding of the grids (0.1 to 1000 ppm, logarithmic).
ReplayGrid.title: ReplayGrid

ReplayIndex.description:
The list of replay files the static build ships (``scenarios/index.json``).

Attributes:
    schema_version: Format version, 1.
    scenarios: One entry per scenario, sorted by ``id``.
ReplayIndex.title: ReplayIndex

ReplayIndexEntry.description:
One scenario in ``index.json`` (same shape as the live API's ``ScenarioSummary``).

Attributes:
    id: Scenario id, for example ``s1_rod_packing``; the file is ``<id>.json``.
    title: Display title.
    duration_h: Scenario length in hours.
    is_mvp: Whether the scenario is part of the MVP set.
ReplayIndexEntry.title: ReplayIndexEntry

ReplayLogEntry.description:
One line of the station log.

Attributes:
    t_s: Time in scenario seconds.
    kind: Entry type (permit, gauging, maintenance, shift_note, calibration).
    tag: Equipment or instrument tag the entry is about, if any.
    text: Entry text.
ReplayLogEntry.title: ReplayLogEntry

ReplayScenario.description:
A complete replayable scenario (simulated station).

Every list is sampled every ``step_s`` seconds (60 s means; a missing mean is ``None``).
``series`` holds the methane sensors (ppm) and every non-methane instrument tag, each with its
unit in ``units``. The weather is real public data (see ``attribution``); the station, the
sensor readings and the instruments are synthetic. The file holds no inversion result.

Attributes:
    schema_version: Format version, 1.
    scenario_id: For example ``s1_rod_packing``.
    title: Display title.
    sim_start_utc: UTC time of scenario second 0, ISO 8601 with ``Z``.
    duration_s: Scenario length in s.
    step_s: Sampling step in s.
    sensors: The methane sensors.
    series: Tag to samples; ``None`` marks a missing sample.
    units: Tag to unit.
    wind_speed_m_s: 60 s mean wind speed in m/s.
    wind_from_deg: 60 s circular mean wind direction in degrees.
    stability: Most frequent Pasquill class in each 60 s sample.
    events: Detection events.
    log: Station log.
    grid: Grid geometry shared by all key frames.
    keyframes: Plume key frames, in time order.
    attribution: Data-source attribution and the real-versus-synthetic label.
    simulated: Always true: the station is fictional and simulated.
ReplayScenario.title: ReplayScenario

ReplaySensor.description:
A methane sensor and where it stands.

Attributes:
    id: Instrument tag, for example ``AT-101``; a key of ``ReplayScenario.series``.
    x_m: East position in m.
    y_m: North position in m.
    z_m: Height in m.
ReplaySensor.title: ReplaySensor

ReplaySource.description:
A true simulated emission, used only to draw the plume.

This is the simulation input, not a measurement and not an estimate: the interface must not
show it as a result.

Attributes:
    anchor_id: Emission-point anchor, for example ``VS-250.tip``.
    rate_kg_h: Simulated methane rate in kg/h.
ReplaySource.title: ReplaySource

Site.description:
The site itself.

Attributes:
    id: Site id, for example ``KS-07``.
    name: Display name.
    fictional: Whether the site is simulated (always true for KS-07).
    bounds: Fence bounds.
    latitude_deg: Latitude used only to fetch weather.
    longitude_deg: Longitude used only to fetch weather.
    elevation_m: Ground elevation in metres.
    ambient_pressure_pa: Ambient absolute pressure in pascals.
Site.title: Site

SiteBounds.description:
Rectangular fence bounds in metres.

Attributes:
    x_min_m: West edge.
    x_max_m: East edge.
    y_min_m: South edge.
    y_max_m: North edge.
SiteBounds.title: SiteBounds

description:
The types shared with the frontend: the facility, a replay scenario and the replay index.

Attributes:
    facility: The KS-07 facility spec.
    replay_scenario: The replay file format.
    replay_index: The ``scenarios/index.json`` format (also the live scenario list entry).
title: Contract
